name: Itou Ayame
source: Ayame is the main protagonist of Corpse Party 2: Dead Patient and a student at Minazuki Academy High School's class 1-5. Having lost her memories, Ayame does not know her own name nor the faces of her friends. Whenever she gets scared, she will let out an odd, squeaky scream. Ayame may have had bad experiences with horror films and haunted houses in her past because she responds poorly to scary situations. In the first chapter, Ayame woke up lying down on an operating table. She has no idea of who she is or why she's there.
